premises.text: Human password behavior is the weak link behind most breaches
premises.evidence_span: over 86% of breaches today are caused by users and not by hackers

premises.text: Existing password tools fail wide adoption because they require teaching users new habits or heavy IT integrations
premises.evidence_span: They either require teaching the user something new, or require integrations which take time, money, and most importantly, a dedicated IT department

premises.text: SSO, IAM, and enterprise password managers store sensitive credentials in the cloud, creating a single point of failure
premises.evidence_span: All of these tools put your sensitive information in the cloud, creating a single point of failure

premises.text: MyKey authenticates on the phone and pushes username, password, and 2FA tokens to the browser without service-provider integrations
premises.evidence_span: MyKey is going to push her username, her password, and even the additional SMS token for two-factor authentication, directly from her phone to her browser

premises.text: Admin portal gives real-time visibility plus revoke/grant, privilege, geo/time/IP rules, and background password changes
premises.evidence_span: As the admin, I have a real-time view of the portal, gives me full visibility and control over users' accounts

premises.text: Product is free for first five users then about $4.99 per additional user per month, aimed first at 10–50 user companies
premises.evidence_span: MyKey is free for the first five users and then starts at $5, $4.99 per additional user per month

value.text: Teams manage digital workspace access securely without complicated, expensive, time-consuming security tools
value.evidence_span: security doesn't have to be something complicated, expensive, and time consuming

causal_links.evidence_span: free for the first five users

notes: Demo feature list (geo fences, scheduled rotations, group provisioning) folded into P5 per §4.1(5). No-integration claim kept inside P4. Early-customer counts excluded as traction. Price and mid-market target kept as one commercial premise per §4.1(3).
